messages:
Maya: Hey team — post-launch cleanup checklist for the benchmark post. Need redirects for renamed urls, schema JSON-LD, internal linking updates, and GTM for the webinar signup flow. Who can own what?
Tom: I'll take keyword mapping + redirect map. Uploading initial csv to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/keyword-map.csv
Aisha: I'll do internal linking and anchor copy. Prioritize linking from /resources and product pages to the benchmark post.
Sam: Quick note on redirects: we should ship redirect map as a single nginx include and test in staging. 301s for renamed slugs, 302 for temporary promos.
Tom: For schema — recommend Article + FAQ schema + mainEntityOfPage. I'll draft JSON-LD. Also add publisher.logo (1200x600) to pass rich result checks.
Aisha: Webinar landing page — need UTM conventions and to make sure form posts tag leads with campaign + source. Who owns Salesforce routing?
Maya: Assign SFDC routing to @Sam or @Ops? Our UTM conventions: utm_source=redwood-marketing, utm_medium=organic or cpc, utm_campaign=benchmark-2026-webinar. Keep utm_term for keyword group.
Sam: Ops can wire SFDC assignment rule. I'll add a hidden input on the form to capture utm params and send to backend.
deploy-bot: staging preview available: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/bench-2026 (deployed by CI)
Sam: nginx redirect snippet to add to /etc/nginx/redirects.conf:
```nginx
# redirects.conf
rewrite ^/old-benchmark-slug/?$ /benchmarks/new-benchmark-slug/ permanent;
rewrite ^/benchmarks/2025/?$ /benchmarks/2026/ permanent;
```
Tom: I'll run Screaming Frog tomorrow and export the redirect test + broken internal links report. Will post CSV.
Aisha: Action list: Tom — redirect map + schema draft (due Tue). Aisha — internal links + anchor text list (due Wed). Sam — redirects include + staging test + SFDC wiring (due Wed). Maya — QA & publish final checklist (due Thu).
Maya: Nice — tagging @Liu from devex for link prefetching and @Ben from analytics for GA4 event mapping. :thumbsup:
